code:
FROM northbridge/storefront-api:2.1
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s --retries=3 \
  CMD curl -f http://localhost:4000/healthz || exit 1
caption: Exit 0 means healthy. Fail --retries times in a row and the container is marked unhealthy.

code:
services:
  api:
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:4000/healthz"]
      interval: 10s
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
caption: condition: service_healthy makes api wait for db's real readiness, not just its start.

steps.label: no / on-failure
steps.sub: never restart, or restart only on a non-zero exit code

steps.label: always
steps.sub: restarts on exit and on daemon restart, even after a manual stop

steps.label: unless-stopped
steps.sub: like always, but a manual stop actually sticks across daemon restarts

subtitle: Doing DB_HOST, passwords, and API keys the right way.
